thread:
alyssa_cs: FYI incoming ticket from Acme on prod. After they rotated their IDP token format to a compact mode, rerank requests started 403-ing.

jordan_support: ticket #AC-4532 says generation + embeddings still work, only rerank failing. can you reproduce? :thinking_face: 

nate_se: can you paste the failing request/response?

alyssa_cs: pasted minimal repro below. customer uses our /v1/rerank endpoint with the same token they use for /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings.

alyssa_cs: ```
$ curl -i -X POST https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/rerank \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOi..." \n  -d '{"queries":["q1","q2"],"cands":["a","b"]}'

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{ "error": "missing_permission", "missing": ["rerank"] }
```

maya_auth: can you dump the token claim? maybe the IdP compressed the scope names.

alyssa_cs: they provided the JWT payload (redacted):

alyssa_cs: ```
{
  "sub": "svc-1234",
  "iss": "https://idp.acme.local",
  "scp": "g,e,r",
  "exp": 1699999999
}
```

nate_se: aha. customer enabled an "compact_scopes" feature that maps full scope words to single-letter codes (g=generate, e=embeddings, r=rerank) on their side. our authorization service used to accept CSV letters but a recent parser change split on commas then tried to match exact scope strings like "generate"|"embeddings"|"rerank" only. regression likely.

maya_auth: I pulled auth logs for svc-1234:

maya_auth: ```
AuthChecker: token=scp["g,e,r"] -> normalized=[] -> denied: missing ["rerank"]
```

jordan_support: so embeddings & generate worked? why were they allowed if normalized==[]?

maya_auth: good catch — there are two code paths. generate/embeds route do a fallback check that translates letters to known permissive aliases; rerank route uses stricter matcher. hence only rerank fails.

oncall_eng: @nate_se can you ship a quick hotfix to the parser to accept single-letter aliases as we had before? customer is blocked on a live batch job.

nate_se: yes. quick mitigation options: 1) ask customer to toggle IDP compact mode off, 2) provision a new token with full-scope names, 3) I'll patch auth-service to treat single-letter CSV as aliases (fast deploy).

alyssa_cs: customer prefers we fix on our side for backward compat. they're on a tight schedule.

nate_se: copying the fix plan: revert the recent strict-scope-parse change and add mapping table {"g":"generate","e":"embeddings","r":"rerank"} plus unit tests. will aim for canary tonight.

maya_auth: also adding a short-term telemetry alert to detect tokens with comma-joined short scopes so we catch other tenants.

oncall_eng: timeframe?

nate_se: canary in us-west in ~4 hours, full roll in ~8 hours if green. will post deploy msg.

jordan_support: noted for customer comms. I'll send them ETA and workaround (create new token with full names). thanks all. :thumbsup:
